D: A Memphis family takes in a homeless teenager who goes on to become a star football player.
P: Serve the main when Leigh Anne switches off the football and gets everyone to the table.
S: Dry-rubbed barbecue wings with a tangy sauce, a taste of Memphis on game day. Toss 1.2kg wings in 2 tbsp smoked paprika, brown sugar and salt.
Southern deviled eggs dusted with paprika, a classic on every Southern table. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and halve.
M: the Thanksgiving when the family eats at the table
Roast turkey with cornbread stuffing, mash and green beans, the family dinner that brings Michael to the table.
W: Sticky pecan pie with vanilla ice cream. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g brown sugar, 150ml golden syrup and 50g melted butter.
K: Sweet iced tea with lemon and mint. Steep 6 tea bags in 1L boiling water with 120g sugar.

s.how: Toss 1.2kg wings in 2 tbsp smoked paprika, brown sugar and salt. Bake at 220C for 45 minutes and serve with 150ml barbecue sauce. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and halve. Mash the yolks with 4 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tsp mustard, pipe back in and dust with paprika.

m.note: the Thanksgiving when the family eats at the table
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg turkey breast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Bake stuffing from 200g crumbled cornbread, onion and celery. Serve with mash from 800g potatoes and 300g green beans.

w.how: Whisk 3 eggs, 150g brown sugar, 150ml golden syrup and 50g melted butter. Stir in 200g pecans, pour into a pastry case and bake at 170C for 45 minutes.

d.how: Steep 6 tea bags in 1L boiling water with 120g sugar. Add 500ml cold water, chill and serve over ice with lemon and mint. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
